## Background

I'm a Senior Data Analyst in Compliance at an asset management firm, where
I build SQL pipelines, Snowflake data models, Power BI dashboards, and
Power Automate workflows supporting compliance monitoring across a global
business. I'm also completing an M.S. in Analytics at Georgia Tech
(expected 2027).

My interest sits at the intersection of regulatory/compliance domain
knowledge and data engineering — building systems that turn regulatory
requirements into auditable, reconciled data pipelines.

## A note on the projects on this site

I can't share anything from my actual compliance work here — no firm data,
internal dashboards, policies, or workflow logic, even redacted or
genericized. Screenshots and "sanitized" exports of real systems can leak
more than they intend to (metadata, layout, thresholds), so instead every
project here is rebuilt from the ground up on data I'm free to use:

- **Public sources** — SEC EDGAR, and similar public regulatory filing
  systems
- **Synthetic datasets** — purpose-built or published synthetic data (e.g.
  synthetic AML transaction sets) where a public real-world source doesn't
  exist

The point isn't just legal safety — it's that rebuilding a workflow from
scratch on public data is a more honest demonstration of whether I actually
understand the underlying problem, rather than just knowing how to operate
one employer's specific system.
